The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] operated a '''garrison''' in [[Geharr]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Ord Gimmel/Legends|Ord Gimmel]]. [[Meilarra]], the Empire's favored candidate for [[Queen/Legends|queen]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], resided in the garrison during the interregnum caused by [[Nehanna]]'s disappearance.<ref name="Strongholds" />
